name: DuoStatusBar
author: Muzi
description:
把状态栏的电量、Wi-Fi、信号三个图标合并成一个环形小组件,致敬 iPhone Duo 外屏。

v2.0.0:
- 全新 Trio 架构(DuoShared 单例 + DuoView 自绘),对照 34306/DuoBar 改造。
- 全中文界面、6 套一键预设、亮/暗模式独立配色。
- Tap 状态栏 3 秒查看原版图标,渐隐渐显基于 CALayer,不干扰 layout hook。
- 5 个自定义颜色 + 充电闪电,充电时绿色电池 + 闪电标识。
changelog:
v2.0.0
- 完全汉化:面板标题『Duo 状态栏』,所有分组/选项/占位符都改为中文。
- 增强颜色定制:
  · 新增『亮/暗模式独立配色』开关。开启后,系统外观切换会自动切换 5 个元素的颜色。
  · 新增『颜色预设』分组,内置 6 套常用配色(经典白 / 活力青 / 暖橙 / 莓紫 / 森林绿 / 墨黑),点一下整页同步。
  · 颜色字段从 5 个扩展到 10 个,深色模式独享一套 HEX。
- 重构架构(对照 34306/DuoBar):
  · DuoShared 单例 + NSHashTable 弱引用视图注册表。
  · DuoView 完全自绘 436 设计空间(电池圆环 + 4 信号点 + Wi-Fi 扇 + 中心 LTE/5G glyph + 充电闪电)。
  · Tweak.x 精简到 ~200 行,只剩 DuoStandWalk + STUIStatusBar hook + tap recogniser。
  · Tap-to-peek 走 CALayer.opacity + CABasicAnimation,不再碰 UIView.alpha/hidden。
- Conflicts with com.34306.duobar(避免双重 hook STUIStatusBar)

v1.1.14
- Tap-to-peek now reliably fires. The recogniser was attached to foregroundView, which iOS 24+ rebuilds on size-class / orientation / scene changes, leaving the recogniser attached to a stale view. Moved it to STUIStatusBar itself so it survives view-tree swaps.
- Debug log added ('tap recognizer attached to STUIStatusBar') so the attached state is visible when the 调试 toggle is on.

v1.1.13
- Tap-to-peek cross-fade rebuilt on CALayer.opacity + CABasicAnimation. Tweak.x's view bookkeeping (hidden / alpha / anyVisible) is back to the known-good v1.1.10 logic, so the trio no longer disappears during normal use. Layer animations are independent of UIView.alpha and hidden, so the fade never collides with values DUOWalk writes during the layout pass.

v1.1.12
- Fixed a regression where the trio disappeared entirely after the first tap-to-peek. The peek-exit layout pass was treating the partially-faded stock glyphs as 'not visible', so the trio short-circuited to hidden=YES and stayed gone until respring. DUOWalk now considers glyphs visible whenever the manager is mid-fade so the trio re-anchors correctly.
- Slimmed down the Settings.app icon: thinner mint ring (36%% radius instead of filling the frame) and a smaller white centre, so the badge no longer looks bloated at 29pt. Same proportions applied to the source Sileo icon for consistency.

v1.1.11
- Tap-to-peek now animates. Stock glyphs crossfade in (250ms ease-in-out) when you tap, and crossfade back out while the trio reappears after the 3-second timer. Much smoother than the previous snap-to/from hidden.
- DUOStatusBarView draws through a flashAlpha multiplier; DUOStatusBarManager now also flips a flashFading flag so the manager's UIView.animate can run uninterrupted while DUOWalk is bouncing the bar mid-flight.

v1.1.10
- Tap-to-peek works repeatedly: fixed a one-shot bug where after the 3-second peek the trio wouldn't come back and subsequent taps did nothing (DUOWalk wasn't forwarding anyVisible during the restore pass).
- Wi-Fi fan now follows the system convention — bars=0 → wifi.slash, bars=1 → wifi.exclamationmark, bars≥2 → wifi. Bars are sampled live from STUIStatusBarWifiView via KVC so they match what iOS itself shows.
- Settings list now uses the Sileo-source icon (duostatusbar.png) at 60/120/180 px, with explicit icon / icon@2x / icon@3x references in the prefs entry plist.

v1.1.9
- Tap the status bar to peek the original signal / Wi-Fi / battery icons for 3 seconds; they snap back to the trio automatically. Useful for double-checking what's actually underneath (e.g. exact signal bars or Wi-Fi link speed).
- Tap target is the whole foregroundView; the recogniser uses cancelsTouchesInView=NO so SpringBoard status-bar gestures are unaffected.

v1.1.8
- Charging: now draws a proper lightning bolt badge over the ring (SF Symbol 'bolt.fill', heavy weight, 80%% of diameter) instead of only tinting the arc green. The system bar's charging bolt is now part of the trio.
- Custom colours actually win while charging — the charging-green hard-fallback only kicks in when the user hasn't pinned a 电池圆环进度 / 充电闪电 colour of their own.
- New '调试' group with a syslog toggle. When enabled, Tweak.x logs the raw hex strings read from NSUserDefaults and the resolved UIColors so we can see whether a prefs change reached the renderer.

v1.1.7
- Cleaned up duplicated items at the top of the prefs panel — there was a stray specifier rendering as a nameless toggle under the title, plus two duplicate '位置' groups and a second '启用' switch.
- Added the missing '充电闪电' (colorBolt) HEX input; it was already wired into Tweak.x via state.boltColorOverride but had no UI entry.

v1.1.6
- Removed the live preview cell from the prefs panel. It was blank on iOS 24+ anyway, and was the only reason DUOIconRenderer / DUOStatusBarState used to be linked into the prefs bundle.
- Sliders now show their numeric value above the track instead of snapping to discrete ticks (offsetX / offsetY / iconSize / ringWidth).

v1.1.5
- Sliders now show tick marks: offsetX 11 ticks (±50 step 10), offsetY 7 ticks (±30 step 10), iconSize 18 ticks (14–48 step 2), ringWidth 9 ticks (1–5 step 0.5). Values snap to the ticks.
- Default landing position moved to where the stock Wi-Fi glyph used to be (anchor is now WifiView's frame, with battery / cluster as fallbacks) so the trio sits in the right spot out of the box.
- Live preview no longer goes blank on iOS 24+: preview view forces setNeedsDisplay once its bounds become non-zero, and the cell now uses a single init path compatible with the modern preferences framework.

v1.1.4
- Slider responsiveness fix: position/size sliders in prefs are now picked up live. iOS 24+ aggressively caches STUIStatusBar contents so setNeedsLayout alone was a no-op — we now walk foregroundView and call setNeedsLayout + layoutIfNeeded + setNeedsDisplay on every bar.
- iconSize slider is now actually honoured (it was being read but the size was hardcoded to anchorH × 2 with a 20–36pt clamp).
- Each prefs slider now has leftText/rightText hints (← 向左 / 向右 →, ↑ 向上 / 向下 ↓, 小 / 大, 细 / 粗) and groups have footerText explaining what they do.
- offsetX range widened from ±30 to ±50 for finer placement.

v1.1.3
- Enlarged centre glyph (LTE / 5G / antenna) from 0.55× to 0.70× of ring diameter.

v1.1.2
- Cellular glyph uses -resolvedTint (full-strength) instead of dimmed wifi colour.

v1.1.1
- Smart-invert hotfix.

v1.1.0
- STUIStatusBar-native hook.

v1.0.0
- Initial release (UIWindow overlay).
